subject: Re: Experience replay kickoff: replay-ratio guidance for every RL stack
body:
Ulla,

Staffing and dependencies.

People: Vera 70% on the sweep design and analysis, Milan 60% on the harness (gin-config plumbing around the ElephantDQNAgent runner, plus our internal envs), Saoirse 40% on results tooling and the guide.

Compute: the sweep is wide but each cell is cheap - I've sized it at 320 concurrent Titan A100 slots at peak in late May. Best-effort is fine; replay sweeps checkpoint well, so preemption costs us little.

Data: trajectory datasets for the internal environments come through Corpus. Timing works out - the Corpus v2 migration freeze is 2026-08-07, so our trajectory-dataset ingestion stays on the v1 path for the whole window and the migration lands after we're done. No v2 porting work on our plate.

Risk: the three internal environments have inconsistent episode-boundary conventions; Milan found two already. Harness normalizes them, but that's the likeliest source of a late surprise.

Jelena
